title: Decay-weighted & skew-aware curation for per-domain quantization calibration packs
creator: Priya Nair
description: Goal: define and implement a reproducible, domain-aware curation and sampling pipeline that produces compact calibration packs used for FP8/INT8 quantization profile generation and accuracy validation. Packs should reflect production traffic distribution while ensuring tail intents and rare-length sequences are represented enough to detect regressions during quantization. This ticket covers algorithm design, target pack sizing, integration points with the data infra, and validation criteria for accepting a calibration pack for a given domain.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible sampler that emits per-domain calibration packs with configurable size (default 50k examples) and deterministic seed
Coverage guarantees: at least X examples for top-10 intents, min Y examples for long-tail intents or a dedup/oversample rule
Pack generation pipeline integrated with batch infra (BigQuery -> S3 staging), with provenance metadata (query id, timestamp, model hash)
Evaluation harness that computes quantization impact metrics (token-level log-likelihood delta, generation fidelity, embedding drift) for FP8 and INT8 profiles
Automated checks that fail pack promotion when degradation exceeds thresholds (see metrics_and_thresholds)
Documentation and runbook for maintaining/refreshing packs monthly or on model rollout
proposed_solution: Sampling kernel: hybrid decay-weighted + stratified approach. Base sample distribution mirrors production traffic by domain-intent but applies an exponential recency decay (lambda tunable) to prioritize recent prompts while not excluding older but frequent patterns.

Skew correction: compute per-intent amplification factors to ensure long-tail intents get a minimum 'floor' of examples. Amplification capped to avoid polluting distribution for highly imbalanced domains.

Length & complexity strata: bucket examples by token-length and perplexity (low/med/high) and force a minimum representation from each bucket to catch quantization sensitivity on long sequences and high-entropy queries.

Prefix-preserving dedup: dedupe by normalized 128-bit hash of first N tokens (N configurable) to avoid near-duplicate prefixes skewing KV cache calibration. Keep a separate pool of intentionally duplicated cases for cache stress tests.

Per-quant-profile tagging: produce metadata that marks which candidate calibration examples were used to derive FP8 vs INT8 scaling stats so we can inspect cross-profile overlaps and unique failure modes.
Determinism: seed + pipeline snapshot recorded in pack manifest for reproducible regeneration and auditability.

Size targeting: default pack sizes: small=10k, default=50k, large=200k. Recommendation: start with 50k for common domains and 10k for low-traffic internal domains. Allow per-domain override via config file in the pipeline repo.
experiment_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Implement sampler in data-pipeline service. Produce pilot packs for 6 representative domains (chatbot-support, search-query, code-completion, summarization, finance-reports, medical-triage).
Phase 2 (1 week): Run quantization profile generation for FP8 and INT8 using pilot packs. Collect evaluation metrics and log failure cases into issue tracker.
Phase 3 (1 week): Iterate sampler params (decay lambda, amplification caps, length-bucket thresholds) to close observed gaps. Re-run profiles and compare.
Phase 4 (1 week): Integrate automated pack validation into CI: pack manifest -> run small validation job -> pass/fail gates before pack promoted to 'gold' storage.
Deliverables: sampler code PR, pack manifest schema, validation job, experiment report summarizing sensitivity by domain and recommended default params.
metrics_and_thresholds: Token log-likelihood delta (quantized - fp32): mean and 95th percentile. Reject pack if mean delta > 0.08 nats/token or 95th percentile > 0.30 for FP8; stricter for INT8 (mean > 0.05, p95 > 0.20).

Generation fidelity: head-to-head human-evaluated preference (or automatic embedding-based similarity). Flag if automated similarity drops more than 2% absolute compared to fp32 baseline for a domain.
Embedding drift: cosine similarity between embeddings from fp32 and quantized model across pack; reject if mean similarity < 0.985 for embedding endpoints used in semantic search domains.
Downstream intent accuracy (where available): drop >1.5% absolute triggers manual review for user-facing domains.
KV-cache stress metric: percent of runs where cache lookup index mismatch or increased generation time >10% under dedup/dup stress cases.
data_sources_and_infra: Primary source: BigQuery production_events table with privacy filters applied. Use anonymized user identifiers and remove PII via existing PII-redaction transforms.
Staging: write raw candidate rows to s3://redwood-calibration-staging/{domain}/{date}/
Manifest stored in config-repo: packs/{domain}/{pack-id}.json with seed, SQL used, hash of pipeline container and commit.
Validation job runs on a dedicated runner (k8s job) that pulls the pack and runs quant evaluation harness. Logs to observability (Console) with per-example failure tags.
risks_and_tradeoffs: Over-amplifying long-tail intents can bias calibration to rare cases and worsen overall token-level statistics — mitigation: cap amplification and measure population-level metrics.
Smaller packs reduce compute time for quant profile derivation but may miss regression modes — mitigation: tiered pack sizes and domain-specific overrides.
Dedupe aggressiveness removes useful near-duplicates that exercise KV cache transitions — mitigation: maintain a separate 'cache-stress' subset that preserves duplicates.
Operational cost: frequent re-generation (daily) is expensive; recommend monthly refresh by default and event-triggered refresh on major traffic shifts or new model rollouts.
